tha-ap130:1.1: Ñāṇasaññaka.] Pabbate Himavantamhi vasāmi pabbatantare / puḷinaṃ sobhanaṃ disvā Buddhaseṭṭhaṃ anussariṃ. // //
tha-ap130:2.1: Ñāṇe upanidhā n' atthi saṅgāmaṃ n' atthi satthuno / sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhiññāya ñāṇena adhimuccati. // //
tha-ap130:3.1: Namo te purisājañña, nāmo te purisuttama! / ñāṇena te samo n' atthi yāvatā ñāṇa-m-uttame. // // Ñāṇe
tha-ap130:4.1: cittaṃ pasādetvā kappam saggamhi mod' ahaṃ / avasesesu kappesu kusalaṃ kāritaṃ mayā. // //
tha-ap130:5.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ saññam alabhiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi ñāṇasaññāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap130:6.1: Ito tesattati kappe eko Puḷinapupphiyo / sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahābalo. // //
tha-ap130:8.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Ñāṇasaññako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
